quoteRequest.description: contains a collection of quote request objects.

sourceCcy.description: Three letter code of source currency

targetCcy.description: Three letter code of target currency

sourceAmount.description: amount of source currency for which the quote is requested - mandatory - if it has a value > 0, targetAmount should be 0

targetAmount.description: amount of target currency for which the quote is requested - mandatory - if it has a value > 0, sourceAmount should be 0

settlementDate.description: expected date of settlement of the quote - optional - mandatory for non indicative quotes

previousQuoteId.description: Allows FXHub to re-use existing and valid quote. Must be used for subsequent requests for the same quote

correlationId.description: an Optional Parameter that specifies the correlation Id for quote association

partnerQuoteRequestParam.description: contains a collection of quote request objects.
